frozen_time: <REQUIRED. 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ' — the single clock of this task; every ctx.now() and every historical time window is measured against it. Choose a credible date consistent with the seed.>
design_rationale: <REQUIRED. A self-contained test dossier kept up to date from the moment the task is first designed, never reconstructed after the fact; every section gives substantive evidence — an original sentence, an id, a row, a formula, a command or an output — so a reviewer can re-verify it without opening any other file. State why this makes a good test; the already-claimed / this-task / still-to-come policy-tool scope; the long and broad policy dependency from the surface goal down to the core calculation; the problem-tree card (root problem, every prerequisite problem, and per edge its kind / gate / condition sentence / policy_source sentence / resolving action, the seed-row evidence that each edge is false at the opening, the topological order, the argument that parallel edges leave the terminal state unambiguous, the per-edge deletion-sensitivity run, and the two proofs that user_scenario mentions no prerequisite and that the tool layer validates none); the base-invariant card (for each exact write subject, every governing policy and, per eligibility, its authoritative evidence and object correlation, plus positive and negative boundary cases for time gates); the business-object card (target key, ledger rows included and excluded, objects already settled); the load-bearing role and open state of each class of row in initial_state; the persona's opening facts, information given only on request, and natural passive reactions; the reachability of every action and every must-ask piece of information in a real conversation; the difficulty for the agent; and the standard solution together with a handling-time recalculation that has actually been executed and is exactly equal to gold. Record item by item the forward references rule -> compute_basis -> compute and the reverse sweep compute -> rule. A workflow-guided task additionally lists, in the step order of the single workflow, the subject / base_policy_refs / computed_by / dataflow, checking each against policy.target_tool/computes and this task's computations.step/arg, to prove that the calculating policy is recomputed at the exact GT call and that steps with an empty computed_by have not lost their base eligibility; it must also carry a zero-wait causal card per step, listing every prerequisite, its source_kind (only initial_state_preexisting / prior_synchronous_tool_effect / current_user_input), its source_locator, the real synchronous business effect of the preceding tool, and the zero_wait_proof, proving that no wait for a real-world event, status registration, persona line or tool-call ordering has been passed off as the event having completed. A non-workflow task proves its own local policy closure instead. Record the eligibility evidence of solvability_contract against GT, and one draft recalculation performed from the expected visible context alone with hidden compute/GT masked. Every revision records the symptom, the root cause, the change, the re-run result and the downstream propagation; extended-policy coverage for the whole difficulty is reviewed across all M tasks together.>
user_scenario:
<Everything the customer simulator knows (the agent cannot see it), written as coherent, natural customer speech in the voice of a specific person; the simulator may say only what is written here. The finished text needs to cover five kinds of information — a real persona, a layperson's situation and surface request, a summarisable surface goal, information given only when asked, and passive reactions to what the agent says or to the outcome of the transaction — but that is a completeness checklist, not a five-part template: do not write labels such as 'Role:', 'Situation:', 'Goal in one line:', 'Only if asked:' or 'Passive reply script:', do not number or block it up, and do not mechanically stack 'if the agent does X -> you say Y'. Weave the triggers and reactions naturally into the character's narration, and vary tone, order, pace, vocabulary and detail with the character; two tasks must not differ only in name, product and numbers. Natural phrasing must still be definite, determinate and reproducible.
The customer does not know internal policy names, table names or tool names. Only the surface request, hard preferences and the natural situation may be volunteered; every existing business fact among them must be independently supported by the opening initial_state, and a charge, status, document or conclusion that only gold produces must never be written as a fact known before the call. Identity attributes, reference numbers, specific fields and cross-category holdings that act as conditions are given verbatim only when the agent asks, and exactly as they appear in initial_state. Internal facts such as approval, review, completion, liability, status, amounts and whether something has already been done are authoritative only as system records; if the customer mentions them naturally they may express only their own observation or memory, must not create a second equally credible truth alongside the official record, and must never stand in for a pending system status so that GT can step over the waiting point. At least 2 self-stated identity fields needed for verification must appear verbatim; internal uuids such as customer_id or holding row ids are never written into the persona — the lookup tools return those. From the perspective of a real agent, fill in every piece of information that would inevitably be asked during handling, even where it never enters gold; if the customer cannot answer, write out explicitly that they cannot and the definite branch that follows — put on hold, rescheduled, or handled according to the existing record — never leaving the simulator to improvise.
When asked about a fact, answer only from initial_state; react in the pre-written way, or close naturally, only after hearing an outcome related to the surface goal. If a real-world event such as a diagnosis, a visit, a delivery, a payment clearing or a manual review has not completed at the opening, the persona may not, after the preceding step, claim it completed during this conversation and thereby trigger the rest of the workflow. Where a cache is inaccurate, the customer may ask for a re-check only on the basis of the opening bill, their experience or a memory already declared, and may never state the correct formula or the exact answer. Stopping conditions may bind only to a few natural utterance events (such as 'accepted / registered / assessed / invoiced'), must not copy gold's steps, parameters or order, and must not inspect the terminal DB state. The customer does not know the correct solution; when the agent misses a step, miscalculates or goes the wrong way, the customer must not correct them with policy, steps or exact numbers, must not volunteer the mechanism, the prerequisites, the ordering or the answer, must not fish for the answer, must not diagnose on the agent's behalf, and must not dump their identity information all at once.>

<row_id — an opaque uuid.uuid4() string.<field>: <value. initial_state IS this task's DB closure: a SEED-FRESH controlled world — the customer + the holding in this category + the EVENT HISTORY the calculation must reconcile + any cross-category holding acting as a condition. There is exactly one copy of the truth; do not add noise rows nobody reads. Business values read as real (real cities/numbers/dates/exact amounts), and only internal row ids are uuids. Fields must exist in db_schema.json. Approval/review/completion/status are authoritative as official records; derived rows such as reversals, compensation and adjustments must carry a unique link to their source object, and must not fall back on customer_id/holding_id/case reference as an implied aggregation scope.>

argument_uniqueness_tracing.<computed_param>: <a calculated parameter: restate the value; then prove uniqueness by drawing out every factor of the compute with its value and source (tier parameter / which stretch of history aggregates to how much / which cross-category condition matched), so that any agent who calculates correctly converges on the same number. The writes of a workflow-guided task execute in workflow order; a non-workflow task performs only its own atomic write. A write by the customer themselves goes unlock_user_discoverable_tool (owner agent) -> call_user_discoverable_tool (owner user), and when the same tool is reused it is unlocked once and called several times.>
argument_uniqueness_tracing.<other_param>: <a non-calculated parameter (enum/fixed-format/verbatim/id): follow the citation discipline of section B and Step 5 in three parts — (1) the value; (2) the basis: refer to and QUOTE VERBATIM the sentence in the charter that pins this value down, naming the source (which policy's rule / which line of which tool docstring / which field of which workflow / which seed row / which customer line); (3) uniqueness: given everything in the agent's context at that step's handling time, why any correct agent converges on the same value — for an enum parameter, say for each remaining candidate why it does not hold. Being unable to produce the verbatim quotation for (2) means the parameter is under-specified: stop and fix the world (preferably remove the parameter and derive it inside the tool; otherwise go back to the rule/docstring and add an exclusive sentence), and never invent a rule to fill the gap. The quotation must match the actual argument and must apply to the situation of this task.>

edges.condition: <the sentence that must hold before `from` can be handled, taken verbatim from the identically named field on the policy side>
edges.policy_source: <the sentence quoted verbatim from the rule / base rule, proving this prerequisite is written into general prose and will therefore be visible to the agent once the KB is rendered>

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: <For parallel prerequisites (one `from` with several out-edges) that may be freely reordered, give an actual run proving that two orders leave the terminal state and every scored parameter identical; where they may not be reordered (a shared balance, a shared cap, a shared dedup key), quote verbatim the policy sentence that pins the order down. Neither of the two = two valid solutions, so go back and fix the policy.>

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: <skip the write of `to`, replay everything else unchanged, and state which scored parameter or terminal field changes, with its value before and after; taken from the prerequisite-sensitivity run of Step 5. prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: <Prove that user_scenario nowhere mentions any prerequisite: it neither names the `to` problem or the thing it resolves, nor drops hints such as 'do I need to sort something out first?' or 'I think there's still an unpaid one' that steer the agent toward the prerequisite. computations.step: <int: the 0-based action index in evaluation_criteria of the call_*_discoverable_tool that receives the result; in a workflow-guided task, that call's workflow step.computed_by must contain this policy_id; in a non-workflow task it need only be a GT write call of this task.>

The gate recomputes policy.compute on the world as it stands at that step's handling time (initial_state plus every gold write before it) and asserts that it == this value == the argument of that call in this task's gold. That handling time is determined by prerequisite_closure.resolution_order: after every prerequisite of this problem (including the transitive closure) has been written, and before this problem itself is written. The root problem's expected must never be evaluated on the opening world — the opening is precisely the world in which its prerequisites are unmet.>
factor_trace: <one line per factor: restate that factor's value plus its source (which base policy / catalogue parameter / derived measure / field; P('...') a tier parameter / SUM(...) which stretch of history aggregating to how much / EXISTS|CPARAM which cross-category condition matched).
